note: No-take marine reserves on this water, for anything that takes from the sea: fishing lines, pots, spears. Read through apps/client/src/fishing/zones.ts (pure; `reservesOf(courseId)`, `reserveAt`). Positions and sizes are approximate, from general knowledge of the two reserves off Avalon, and both are treated as plain no-take. Flat metres east and north of the course origin.

reserves.name: Casino Point
reserves.say: Casino Point is a marine reserve and a dive park: nothing may be taken here.

reserves.name: Lover's Cove
reserves.say: Lover's Cove is a marine reserve: look, and take nothing.
